section_summary: This section records U.S. responses to proposed visits by Japanese vessels in 1938 and 1939. The Hakuho Maru’s Aleutian cruise prompted discussion of surveillance and customary courtesies; the Nanho Maru sought to call at Zamboanga. Most of the section concerns the Hakuyo Maru’s planned visits to St. Paul Island, Dutch Harbor, and Honolulu, including their connection to fur seal protection.

subfiles.title: Treasury reply concerning the Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: Coast Guard instructions for the Hakuho Maru’s Aleutian cruise.
subfiles.summary: Treasury says the Coast Guard will extend customary courtesies and facilities in Alaskan waters.

subfiles.title: War Department reply concerning the Hakuho Maru
subfiles.from: Secretary of War Harry H. Woodring
subfiles.about: Possible shelter and water stops at Attu and Atka.
subfiles.summary: War cannot extend courtesies because it has no personnel or installations on the islands.

subfiles.title: Conversation on the Hakuho Maru’s Aleutian visit
subfiles.about: Interdepartmental discussion of the Japanese request for Aleutian port calls.
subfiles.summary: Ballantine, Struble, and Bower discussed surveillance, access to the vessel during port calls, and possible effects of refusal on salmon and fur seal arrangements. Navy and Fisheries undertook prompt consideration.

subfiles.title: Coast Guard message on Hakuho Maru’s Atka visit
subfiles.about: Reported movements of the Hakuho Maru at Atka.
subfiles.summary: A report says the ship arrived May 29 and departed June 1, reportedly for Japan because of engine trouble.

subfiles.title: Interior reply concerning the Hakuho Maru
subfiles.about: Proposed Hakuho Maru calls at Attu and Atka.
subfiles.summary: Interior has no objection and has advised Alaska’s governor to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for the Nanho Maru’s Zamboanga visit
subfiles.about: A proposed training ship visit to Zamboanga from October 30 to November 2.
subfiles.summary: The ambassador requests permission for the visit and crew landing, with customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: State notice to Navy concerning the Nanho Maru
subfiles.about: The proposed Nanho Maru visit and crew landing at Zamboanga.
subfiles.summary: State confirms its telephone notice and proposes a prohibition on fishing in Philippine territorial waters.

subfiles.title: State request to War concerning the Nanho Maru
subfiles.about: Customary courtesies for the Nanho Maru at Zamboanga.
subfiles.summary: State requests courtesies if there is no objection, subject to no fishing in Philippine territorial waters.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of the Nanho Maru request
subfiles.about: Receipt of the request for the Nanho Maru’s Zamboanga visit.
subfiles.summary: State says it has contacted the relevant federal authorities about customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: War reply concerning the Nanho Maru
subfiles.about: War Department review of the Zamboanga visit.
subfiles.summary: War reports no objection; the High Commissioner has arranged customary courtesies with the Commonwealth government.

subfiles.title: Navy reply concerning the Nanho Maru
subfiles.from: Acting Secretary of the Navy William D. Leahy
subfiles.about: Naval approval of the Nanho Maru’s Zamboanga visit.
subfiles.summary: Navy has no objection and has told local authorities to extend customary courtesies and facilities.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for the Hakuyo Maru’s 1939 visits
subfiles.about: Proposed calls at St. Paul Island, Dutch Harbor, and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: The ambassador gives the ship’s schedule and explains that Tokyo Fishing Institute students seek to study fur seal breeding and protection at St. Paul. He requests approval for the visits, crew landings, and customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: State acknowledgment of the Hakuyo Maru request
subfiles.about: Review of the Hakuyo Maru’s proposed calls.
subfiles.summary: State acknowledges the request and promises a decision after consulting interested federal departments.

subfiles.title: State approval of the Hakuyo Maru visits
subfiles.about: Federal approval of the Hakuyo Maru’s planned calls.
subfiles.summary: State reports no departmental objection and says customary courtesies and facilities will be extended.

subfiles.title: State request to Agriculture concerning the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Customary courtesies for the Hakuyo Maru’s planned calls.
subfiles.summary: State relays the schedule, captain, complement, and purpose of the St. Paul visit.

subfiles.title: State inquiry to Commerce concerning the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Commerce Department approval of the planned visits.
subfiles.summary: State encloses the Japanese note and asks whether Commerce approves the three calls.

subfiles.title: State request to Interior concerning the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Interior Department courtesies for the planned visits.
subfiles.summary: State provides the schedule and St. Paul purpose and requests customary courtesies if there is no objection.

subfiles.title: State request to Labor concerning the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Labor Department courtesies for the planned visits.
subfiles.summary: State requests customary courtesies and repeats the itinerary and fur seal study purpose.

subfiles.title: Far Eastern Affairs memorandum on the St. Paul request
subfiles.about: Precedent and diplomatic considerations for admitting the Hakuyo Maru to St. Paul Island.
subfiles.summary: The memorandum recalls a similar 1937 permission expressly said not to set a precedent. It warns that refusal could affect the Fur Seal Convention and Alaska salmon arrangement, and recommends awaiting Navy and Commerce replies before approaching other departments.

subfiles.title: State inquiry to Navy concerning the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Naval courtesies for the Hakuyo Maru’s three planned calls.
subfiles.summary: State forwards the itinerary and asks Navy to arrange customary courtesies if it has no objection.

subfiles.title: State request to War concerning the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: War Department courtesies for the planned visits.
subfiles.summary: State requests customary courtesies and sets out the itinerary and St. Paul study purpose.

subfiles.title: State request to Treasury concerning the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Treasury Department courtesies for the planned visits.
subfiles.summary: State requests customary courtesies and describes the ship’s schedule and fur seal study at St. Paul.

subfiles.title: Labor acknowledgment concerning the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.from: Deputy Commissioner E. D. J. Shaughnessy
subfiles.about: Immigration offices’ notice of the Hakuyo Maru’s itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Labor acknowledges State’s letter and says its Seattle and Honolulu offices are being advised.

subfiles.title: War reply concerning the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.from: Secretary of War Harry H. Woodring
subfiles.about: Military courtesies during the Honolulu visit.
subfiles.summary: War has instructed the Hawaiian Department’s commanding general to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Interior reply concerning the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Interior Department review of the three planned visits.
subfiles.summary: Interior sees no objection to the Hakuyo Maru’s calls.

subfiles.title: Commerce reply concerning the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.from: Assistant Secretary of Commerce Richard C. Patterson Jr.
subfiles.about: Commerce Department review of the proposed calls.
subfiles.summary: Commerce has no objection and asks to be told if St. Paul permission is granted so Fisheries staff can extend courtesies.

subfiles.title: Treasury reply concerning the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.from: Assistant Secretary of the Treasury Stephen B. Gibbons
subfiles.about: Customs arrangements for the planned calls.
subfiles.summary: Treasury authorizes customs courtesies at Honolulu and Dutch Harbor and alerts Juneau to the St. Paul visit.

subfiles.title: Navy reply concerning the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.from: Acting Secretary of the Navy William D. Leahy
subfiles.about: Naval review of the visits and access to St. Paul Island.
subfiles.summary: Navy raises no objection and understands the Fur Seals Treaty to imply a right to visit the breeding grounds.

subfiles.title: Coast Guard instructions for the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.to: Commander, Bering Sea Patrol Force; Commander, San Francisco Division
subfiles.about: Courtesies in Alaskan and Hawaiian waters.
subfiles.summary: The Commandant directs feasible Coast Guard courtesies during the approved visits.

subfiles.title: Telegram announcing permission for the Hakuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Notification of approval for the three port visits.
subfiles.summary: State announces permission and asks the embassy to notify the consul at Yokohama.
